fields.PRODUCT NAME: Handcrafted Wooden Lord Ganesha Idol – Rajasthani Art Sculpture
fields.DESCRIPTION: Invite blessings, wisdom, and prosperity into your home with this exquisite hand-carved wooden Lord Ganesha idol, crafted by skilled artisans of Rajasthan. Known as the remover of obstacles and the harbinger of good fortune, Lord Ganesha is revered in every Indian household. This unique piece showcases intricate craftsmanship, with detailed carving that highlights traditional Rajasthani artistry. The umbrella-style canopy above adds a divine aura, making it a perfect blend of spirituality and elegance.
